covered_actors: providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
compliance_deadlines: Framework must be confirmed no later than four weeks after notifying the Commission pursuant to Article 52(1) AI Act
Framework must be confirmed no later than two weeks before placing the model on the market
implementation_notes: This Code of Practice is a voluntary instrument under the EU AI Act. Adherence serves as a means for providers to demonstrate compliance with Articles 53 and 55 AI Act obligations, but does not constitute conclusive evidence of compliance. SMEs and SMCs may benefit from simplified compliance paths including exemptions from some reporting commitments per Article 56(5) AI Act. The document is the Safety and Security Chapter specifically, focused on systemic risk assessment and mitigation across the model lifecycle.
